purpose: Prove full parity between the accepted Stage 2-1 Skin -> Hero relation and Stage 2-2 Hero -> ordered Skin reverse index, then publish one Skin-domain bidirectional checkpoint for downstream consumers without reopening raw ConfigData semantics.
consumerRules: Skin consumers must resolve ownership through bySkinId and must not recalculate owner from raw ConfigData.
Hero consumers must resolve regular-skin membership and order through byHeroId and must not re-read ConfigDataHeroInfo.Skins_ID[] for a fresh relation.
byHeroId must include all 267 canonical Heroes, including 32 entries with an empty array.
byHeroId ordering must preserve Stage 2-1 sourceOrder exactly; skinId numeric sorting is forbidden.
prohibitions: Do not read raw ConfigData or Hero Stage 5-5 as a new relation authority.
Do not add skin names, acquisition metadata, asset paths, release state, localization, displayTarget or KR_FUTURE fields to this relation checkpoint.
Do not infer, renumber or re-sort sourceOrder.
Do not omit Heroes with zero regular skins.
completionRule: 2-3 completes only when both upstream Stage 2-1 and Stage 2-2 validations are PASS, the bidirectional checkpoint contains 540 unique bySkinId entries and 267 byHeroId entries with exactly 540 reverse edges, and owner/edge/order parity mismatches are all zero.
nextAction: Skin 2-4: verify the accepted Stage 2 bidirectional checkpoint against the frozen Stage 1 canonical/Hero Stage 5-5 parity baseline without reopening raw ownership discovery.
